Hello everyone!

Just a quick update to expand the How to Play screen, giving more insight about the Day/Night cycle and the trapped vegetable companions.

notes.title: V0.5.4 Beekeeper Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This new update brings some changes regarding game balance, but most importantly it introduces our new addition to the roster:

[h2]New character: Beekeeper[/h2]
This unlockable character joins the battle with 3 new tools and a special companion that radically changes her gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149894/b3cc982ae1ab7bfc2970875a36405e4b8a51f4d3.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149894/58fd3f7c1cd04547eb9c6a53b095b5ea351c89bb.gif[/img]

[h2]New feature: Magnet Shard[/h2]
This rare item will now appear during new runs, collect it to draw all the water in the map right to you!


[h3]Misc changes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] New challenges (along with new Steam Achievements) have been added to the game. The Progress screen is not in its final state yet, it will be revised and expanded for the early access release;
[*] Projectile sprites are now mirrored when shot on the left side instead of being rotated.
[/list]

[h3]Balance changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies amount have been generally increased throughout the whole run;
[*] Enemies can now spawn both closer and farther than before;
[*] Cactus, shrubs and trees spawn points have been rearranged, and cactus now yield more water units;
[*] It’s now required to stay for a very short time in proximity to vegetable companions to collect them.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.3 Weather Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The 0.5.3 Update is live right now, and I suggest bringing an umbrella because 
the days spent slaying creatures and saving veggies won't be warm and sunny anymore!

[h1]New feature: Weather System[/h1]
Besides the usual clear skies, days and nights will now have a chance to come with particular weather,
each with its pros and cons that will modify the playing field.
In the Prologue Scenario you can expect to encounter:
[h2]Rain[/h2]
With water falling from the sky, it's a perfect chance to stock up for a bountiful harvest,
but beware of the puddles scattered around because they'll slow you down and make you an easy target
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149894/532efeab27ce3e1b8b8d25b107ffb6b75af50074.gif[/img]
[h2]Fog[/h2]
All these fog banks will make it harder to see a thing, but it counts for the enemy creatures as well,
as they'll move slower making their way to you
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149894/e08130852c7097a9c1634cfc065fca036c348412.gif[/img]


[h2]Calendar and Forecast[/h2]
The ready screen at the beginning of a wave has been updated, with a weather forecast for your current and next wave, and a calendar to help you keep track of your progress throughout the run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44149894/932a584f86c215e64e3457b531b4585ae9b1dad8.jpg[/img]

Alongside this feature, there are additional changes:
-Redesigns for both the Spring Trees and the Blackberry enemy creature
-Fixed a bug that modified Tools values incorrectly when applying the Fig Item Effect

notes.title: v0.5.21 Hotfix
notes.notes:
A quick patch for a bug that was found in the latest version:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would freeze the game at the end of the wave after defeating the Pepper-Oni for the first time
[*] Achievements pop-ups are now shown at the end of a wave to avoid cluttering the screen during the fight
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.21 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] _Owlnions_ now slow down after hitting the player, and their speed increase is more consistent
[*] _End Scenario Boss_ has a reworked phase 2, with a shorter attack cooldown and slightly increased movement speed
[*]  General enemy spawn times and positions adjustments
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause _Pepper-Oni_ to drop the reward item multiple times

[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] _Owlnions_ might get stuck after being stunned and not resume their movement
[/list]

notes.title: Noxious Weeds: Prologue is a farming themed Vampire Survivors
notes.notes:
You retired and wanted to farm but evil creatures just won't leave you in peace, now you have to defend your farm with the help of some veggies. Noxious Weeds: Prologue is the latest take on the craze of Vampire Survivors.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/06/noxious-weeds-prologue-is-a-farming-themed-vampire-survivors

notes.title: v0.5.2 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to switch between 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios
[*] Stats in the pause menu list can now be selected and have their own description
[*] Localization added for Simplified Chinese and Italian
[*] Clouds and fireflies weather effects added on Spring map
[*] New visual effect for [u]Shears[/u] tool (and hitbox resized accordingly)
[/list]

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted tool range/size scaling for: [u]Pitchfork[/u], [u]Broom[/u], [u]Machete[/u], [u]Watering Can[/u]
[*] [u]Half Apple[/u] ([strike]+5 HP Max | -5 Damage [/strike]→ +5 HP Max | -1 Damage)
[*] [u]Spinach[/u] ([strike]"100% Critical Hit chance on enemies below +11% Health"[/strike] → +20% Critical Chance | -10% Tool Range)
[*] [u]Butternut Squash[/u] moved from Tier 1 to Tier 2
[*] Increased [u]Pumpkin[/u] seed travel speed.
[*] Removed Stack limit for: [u]Spinach[/u], [u]Carrot[/u], [u]Broccoli[/u], [u]Porcino[/u]
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug where some vitamins would not be gathered correctly and stick to the player's feet

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
- Some loot dropped right at the end of a wave might not despawn correctly

notes.title: Patch v0.5.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Misc changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added controller navigation to the Delete Save button and sub-menu in the Progress screen
[*] It's now possible to navigate to a previous menu using the B button on a controller or Esc/Backspace on keyboards
[*] It's now possible to check the inventory during level-ups and harvesting
[*] Game pauses when Steam overlay opens
[*] Game pauses after a controller has been unplugged
[*] The description box in the inventory is much larger
[/list]
